public_definitions: Review the monthly air-quality alert dashboard and assign January to the operational route that fits its position relative to the monthly average alert load.
Use the monthly reported alert totals shown in the dashboard as the basis for this routing decision when determining January's standing against the average alert load.

The options are: Route January to above-average air-quality alert response review, Route January to average-range air-quality alert monitoring, Route January to below-average air-quality alert background monitoring.
